history.administration_response: The United Nations Logistics Base incorporated measures to improve strategic deployment stocks management into the 2025/26 budget proposal. These measures are intended to balance the rapid deployment needs of mission start-up phases with effective strategic deployment stocks obsolescence risk management. The revised strategic deployment stocks framework also emphasizes holistic solutions and strategic stock locations, addressing a broader scope that includes disaster response, health emergencies and ongoing operations. The Administration considers this recommendation to be implemented and requests its closure by the Board.
